slides.title: A break from Fractals
bullets: Fractals were the most represented strategy of the .asphodel/paradise season
Recent improvements made the deck more efficient
Player frustration with the matchup has been building over time
Fractal players will have to rethink how they turn their board into a win

slides.title: More room for aggro
bullets: Recovery tools that helped Umbra Ciel and Exia Jin survive early pressure
Without them, aggressive decks can turn early pressure into wins
Umbra Ciel and Exia Jin players must find new ways to defend

slides.title: Leaving the Seasonal Banlist
bullets: Baleful Oblation, Fabled Azurite Fatestone and Spirit Blade: Ascension return on December 11th, 2026
Their strategies will face a field reshaped by the new bans and the new set

slides.title: Seasonal Banlist in short
bullets: Effective December 11th, 2026, with the release of .asphodel/cantabile
Temporary: it lasts from one main-set release to the next
A card can't be seasonally banned in consecutive seasons
Cards are eligible only after three main-set releases
slides.note: Long-term balance issues are still handled by the regular Banned & Restricted list.
